info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Lazurite Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Lazurite Recliner Detail Submission API enables businesses to create and manage detailed entries for the Lazurite recliner in their product catalog. This endpoint allows for the inclusion of specifications, features, and unique selling points of the recliner, ensuring that product information is accurate and comprehensive. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and catalog management tools. This API streamlines the process of adding new recliner details, enhancing overall product presentation for customers.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information regarding the Lazurite recliner. You can specify various attributes to define the recliner's specifications and features, making it easier for customers to understand its value.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details for creating or updating a Lazurite recliner's information. The data must be formatted in JSON and adhere to the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

lazurite_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the Lazurite recliner.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order should be prioritized.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the recliner.
